source_excerpt:
Vacancies: 350 (including backlog) · Posts: 2 designation(s) · Type: Central PSU · Probationary Engineer (E-II Grade) · Mode: Online · Fee: ₹1,180 (GEN/EWS/OBC-NCL) / Nil (SC/ST/PwBD/ESM) · Apply: 28 Oct–18 Nov 2026 · Salary: ₹40,000–₹1,40,000 (CTC approx. ₹13 lakh) · Selection: CBT + Interview · Location: Multiple BEL units across India
Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL), a Navratna PSU under the Ministry of Defence, invites applications for 350 Probationary Engineer posts in E-II Grade. The drive covers Electronics and Mechanical disciplines for production and support roles. BEL designs and manufactures professional electronics systems for defence and related sectors.
BEL Probationary Engineer Bharti 2026 covers 350 posts across BEL units and offices in India. Selected candidates may be posted to Bangalore, Ghaziabad, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, and other listed locations, or any BEL unit as required. The advertisement is Advt. No. 17556/HR/All-India/2026 dated 28 October 2026.
Engineering graduates with the printed qualifications can apply online at the BEL careers portal from 28 October 2026 (02:00 PM) to 18 November 2026 (11:59 PM). Selection is through a computer-based test followed by an interview.
⚠️ Application Alerts: check these before you submit the form.
Non-receipt of the application fee for GEN/EWS/OBC (NCL) leads to rejection of the application (see rejection rules).
Category once filled cannot be changed after submission.
Specialisation in the degree certificate must match the branch chosen in the application, or the candidate will not be considered for an interview.
Colour blindness is not suitable for either discipline under the company’s medical standards.

Who Should Apply? (Quick Eligibility Check)
B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc (4 Years) Engineering Graduate in Electronics / Electronics and Communication / Electronics & Telecommunication / Communication / Telecommunication (First class for UR/OBC-NCL/EWS; Pass for SC/ST/PwBD) from AICTE-approved colleges → Probationary Engineer (Electronics) – 200 posts
B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc (4 Years) Engineering Graduate in Mechanical (First class for UR/OBC-NCL/EWS; Pass for SC/ST/PwBD) from AICTE-approved colleges → Probationary Engineer (Mechanical) – 150 posts
First class in AMIE / AMIETE / GIETE in the above disciplines also eligible.
Quick Overview – BEL Probationary Engineer Recruitment 2026
Organisation: Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL)
Recruitment / Exam Name: BEL Probationary Engineer Recruitment 2026
Notification / Advertisement No.: 17556/HR/All-India/2026
Post(s): Probationary Engineer (Electronics) in E-II Grade; Probationary Engineer (Mechanical) in E-II Grade
Total Vacancies: 350 (including backlog; 2 designations)
Job Location: Production/Support Services departments of BEL Units/Offices at Bangalore (Karnataka), Ghaziabad (UP), Pune/Nagpur/Navi Mumbai (Maharashtra), Hyderabad/Ibrahimpatnam (Telangana), Chennai (Tamil Nadu), Palasamudram/Nimmaluru/Machilipatnam (Andhra Pradesh), Panchkula (Haryana), Kotdwara (Uttarakhand), or any place in India at Management discretion
Job Type / Nature: Central PSU · Probationary Engineer (E-II Grade)

Apply Between: 28 October 2026 to 18 November 2026
Apply Online: BEL Careers Portal (opens 28 October 2026)

What Posts Are Available? – BEL Probationary Engineer Vacancy 2026
Electronics holds 200 of the 350 posts (about 57%), and Mechanical holds 150. Both include backlog vacancies. Management may increase or decrease the number in each specialisation.
PwBD is horizontal. Electronics: 7 reserved + 20 backlog (total 27 including backlog). Mechanical: 6 reserved + 12 backlog (total 18 including backlog). Suitable disabilities are listed in the notice for each post (LV, D/HH, OA/BA/OL, etc., and MD involving the listed categories).
Who Is Eligible for BEL Probationary Engineer 2026? – Education, Age & Domicile
Nationality, Domicile & Basic Requirements
Nationality: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
Domicile / local condition: The notice does not state a domicile or residence condition.
UR / OBC (NCL) / EWS candidates need First class in B.E. / B.Tech / B.Sc. (4 Years) Engineering Graduate from AICTE-approved colleges in the listed Electronics disciplines or Mechanical. SC/ST/PwBD candidates need a Pass class in the same. Candidates with first class in AMIE / AMIETE / GIETE in the above disciplines are also eligible. Other equivalent disciplines and dual specialisations will NOT be considered.
For CGPA/GPI/SGPA, the conversion formula issued by the Institute/University applies. The conversion certificate must be submitted at the interview if shortlisted; failure leads to disqualification.
Qualification must be held by: Not separately stated beyond the degree requirements.
Need to convert CGPA? Use our CGPA to Percentage Calculator . This calculator gives an indicative estimate; the official method in the notification prevails.
What Is the Age Limit? (as on 01 October 2026)
✅ A 24-year-old UR candidate born on 1 January 2002 — eligible (as on 01 October 2026).
❌ A 26-year-old UR candidate born on 1 January 2000 — not eligible (one full year over the limit).
Use our Age Eligibility Calculator to check instantly.
Reservation: Vertical reservation as printed (UR, EWS, OBC-NCL, SC, ST). Horizontal PwBD reservation as per government guidelines, with backlog included. OBC creamy layer must apply as Unreserved. EWS certificate based on FY 2025-26 income issued on or after 01.04.2026. OBC certificate on or after 01.10.2025 in prescribed format.
PwBD: Posts identified as suitable for listed disability categories (minimum 40% disability). Temporary disabilities “likely to improve” are not eligible for reservation. Colour blindness is not suitable.
What Is the Salary? – Pay Scale & Benefits
Basic pay scale ₹40,000-3%-₹1,40,000 (due for revision w.e.f. 01.01.2027). Approximate CTC ₹13 lakh. In addition to basic pay, selected candidates will be entitled to DA, HRA, Conveyance Allowance, Performance Related Pay, Medical Reimbursement and other perquisites as admissible.
Benefits (as printed): DA, HRA, Conveyance Allowance, Performance Related Pay, Medical Reimbursement and other perquisites as admissible.
This is a PSU scale; no indicative in-hand amount is calculated here.
Payment mode: Online via SBI e-Pay Lite payment gateway (Debit/Credit Card/Net Banking/Wallets/UPI). Refund: The application fee once paid will not be refunded.
The BEL Probationary Engineer online form 2026 is filled out on the BEL careers portal from 28 October 2026 (02:00 PM) to 18 November 2026 (11:59 PM).
Open the BEL Careers Portal (opens on 28 October 2026).
Register with personal details and contact details; receive User ID and password via email/SMS. Verify OTP for mobile and email.
Complete personal, qualification and other details. Upload a recent passport-size colour photograph (not older than 3 months, 100–200 KB, JPG, 3.5 cm × 4.5 cm, white background, 200 dpi) and signature (80–150 KB, JPG).
Preview, submit the application and pay the fee (if applicable) via SBI e-Pay Lite.
Print the application form and payment acknowledgement for future reference. No hard copy is to be sent to BEL.
Waiting until the last day; BEL is not responsible for last-minute rush issues.
Uploading a photograph older than 3 months or not matching the specifications.
Choosing a branch that does not match the specialisation on the degree certificate.
Not keeping the printed application form and payment slip.
Applying multiple times; only the application with the higher Application Sequence Number is considered.
BEL Probationary Engineer भर्ती 2026 – 350 पद
भारत इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स लिमिटेड (BEL), रक्षा मंत्रालय के अंतर्गत एक नवरत्न पीएसयू, 350 प्रोबेशनरी इंजीनियर पदों के लिए आवेदन आमंत्रित करता है। इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स और मैकेनिकल दोनों में भर्ती है।
अंतिम तिथि कब है? ऑनलाइन आवेदन 28 अक्टूबर 2026 (दोपहर 2 बजे) से 18 नवंबर 2026 (रात 11:59 बजे) तक भरा जा सकता है।
कौन आवेदन कर सकता है? AICTE-अनुमोदित कॉलेज से B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc (4 वर्ष) इंजीनियरिंग डिग्री वाले उम्मीदवार। UR/OBC/EWS के लिए फर्स्ट क्लास, SC/ST/PwBD के लिए पास क्लास। केवल भारतीय नागरिक।
आवेदन कैसे करें? bel-india.in के करियर सेक्शन पर ऑनलाइन फॉर्म भरें। कोई हार्ड कॉपी नहीं भेजनी है।
वेतन और चयन कैसे होगा? बेसिक पे ₹40,000 से ₹1,40,000 (CTC लगभग ₹13 लाख)। चयन कंप्यूटर बेस्ड टेस्ट (85 अंक) और इंटरव्यू (15 अंक) से होगा।
Online application accepted and eligibility checked.
Computer Based Test (CBT): 85 marks weightage. Shortlisting for interview in a 1:5 ratio, discipline-wise and category-wise.
Final selection based on combined performance. Minimum qualifying marks: 35% for General/OBC/EWS and 30% for SC/ST/PwBD in both CBT and interview separately.
Negative marking: 1/4th of the marks deducted for each wrong answer. No marks for unattempted or marked-for-review questions. Bilingual (English and Hindi); English version prevails in case of variation.
The syllabus focuses on core engineering subjects of the respective discipline plus General Aptitude and Reasoning. No detailed annexure syllabus is printed beyond this.
Candidates choose 5 preferred centres nearest to their correspondence address from Annexure-A. Allocation depends on availability. No change request allowed. Travel for CBT is not reimbursed.
The list is tentative and not exhaustive. BEL reserves the right to change the centre/city/state based on the number of candidates and availability of centres. CBT is tentatively on 22 December 2026.
The SahisarkariJobs.in Analyst's Take – Is This Recruitment for You?
This is a large entry-level engineering drive at a defence electronics Navratna PSU. The 85:15 CBT-to-interview split means the computer-based test decides most of the shortlist, with a 1:5 call-up ratio. First-class marks (or pass for reserved categories) and exact discipline match are hard gates. The two-year service agreement with a ₹2 lakh breach amount is a clear commitment after six months of training.
Best fit: Fresh or recent AICTE-approved B.E./B.Tech graduates in the exact listed Electronics or Mechanical branches who score well in objective tests and accept all-India posting. What is the last date to apply for BEL Probationary Engineer 2026?
18 November 2026 (11:59 PM). No extension has been announced as of 27 October 2026.
What is the age limit for BEL Probationary Engineer?
25 years for UR/EWS as on 01 October 2026. Relaxation: 3 years for OBC (NCL), 5 years for SC/ST and ESM, 10 years for PwBD (additional for combined categories). Age is calculated as on 01 October 2026.
Is there an exam for BEL Probationary Engineer, or is it interview-based?
CBT (85 marks) followed by an interview (15 marks). Shortlisting for the interview is 1:5. Minimum qualifying marks 35% (General/OBC/EWS) or 30% (SC/ST/PwBD) in each stage separately. Negative marking of 1/4th.
What is the salary for Probationary Engineer posts in this recruitment?
Basic pay ₹40,000-3%-₹1,40,000 (revision due from 01 January 2027). Approximate CTC ₹13 lakh. DA, HRA, Conveyance Allowance, Performance Related Pay, Medical Reimbursement and other perquisites as admissible.
